payouts.title: Pay out (Bhuktani)
payouts.description: Pay net salaries through your bank or a wallet. Money goes from your account straight to workers — KaamSathi never holds it.
payouts.approve_first: Approve this payroll run to pay workers through a bank file or wallet.
payouts.never_hold_funds: When every payment is marked paid, the payroll run is marked paid automatically and workers get an SMS.
payouts.eligible: {count, plural, =0 {No workers} one {# worker} other {# workers}}
payouts.created_toast: {count, plural, one {Batch created for # worker} other {Batch created for # workers}}
payouts.use_bank_file: Wallet payouts need a merchant agreement — use the bank file for now.
payouts.bank_steps: 1. Download the CSV/XLSX · 2. Upload it in your bank's bulk-transfer screen · 3. Click “Mark file uploaded” · 4. Upload the bank's result file or mark each payment.
payouts.cancel_body: Its workers become available for a new batch. Nothing is sent to anyone.
payouts.reconcile_body: We match each row by reference, or by account number and amount, and mark payments paid or failed.
payouts.result_hint: Columns we read: reference, account, amount, status, bank_ref, remarks.
